levels.text: A water-stained Almanac. The hints are vague and sometimes wrong.
A few pages glued back in. Hints mention the kind of thing folks want.
Freshly rebound. Hints are usually right.
Annotated in Grandma's handwriting. Hints narrow it down a lot.
The legendary edition. It names the hot items outright.

pages.title: Year One: Coming Home
pages.text: The land is ours again. The brambles have had their turn; now it's ours.

pages.title: Year Two: Deep Roots
pages.text: The farm is whole. This year, it's about making it ours, and making it shine.

pages.title: Year Three: Blue Ribbons
pages.text: The County Fair knows our name now. Grandpa would be proud.

pages.title: Year Four: Heirlooms
pages.text: Seeds saved from our best harvests. Every year a little richer.

pages.title: Year Five and Beyond
pages.text: Every year on the farm is a new chapter. This one is yours to write.
